items.question: In what year was the UAE Gender Balance Council established?
items.fact: Gender Balance Council established in 2015 to empower Emirati women

items.question: Which international organisation prepared the Gender Balance Guide: Actions for UAE Organisations published by the UAE Gender Balance Council?
items.gold: The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
items.fact: Gender Balance Guide prepared by OECD for UAE organisations
